pitches.logline: In 1899 the Belgian Camille Jenatzy wants to pass 100 km/h on the road at Acheres near Paris; no road vehicle has done it, and his torpedo car has no engine anyone expects.
pitches.hook: FreezeTag on the torpedo car, a 1899 tag, the run already under way, a whine

pitches.logline: You think electric cars are the future; in 1899 an electric car already held the speed record, and in 1900 Porsche's car with motors in its wheels was shown in Paris.
pitches.hook: KeywordLift: the word new lifted over the car and struck through

pitches.logline: I buy an electric car, my friend Dato calls me ლენჩი for buying a toy of the future; I want to win the argument and his certainty stands in the way until I show him 1899.
pitches.hook: FreezeTag on the record car's photo, 1899 on it, as the insult is spoken

treatment.logline: I buy an electric car, my friend Dato calls me ლენჩი for buying a toy of the future; I win the argument with 1899, and he still is not satisfied.
treatment.hero: me, the narrator, arguing with my made-up friend Dato over one car: La Jamais Contente, Acheres 1899
treatment.obstacle: Dato is sure electric cars are a new fashion

hook.event: frame 0: the record car's photo pushing in, 1899 on it, the camera shutter freezing it as Dato's insult is spoken

act1: Dato: electric cars are a new fashion; I bring up Camille Jenatzy, the Belgian they called the Red Devil
his car went past 100 km/h at Acheres in 1899, 105.88 on the scale
Dato still does not give in, so Ferdinand Porsche's 1900 car with motors in its wheels
treatment.turn: the twist: the first road car past 100 km/h ran on electricity, held 0.7 s on the signature card

reveal.what: Porsche's hybrid on its photo, its engine block and hub ringed: among his cars was the first hybrid

treatment.payoff: Dato hears it all and now says it is old news; the car's name, never satisfied, fits him
treatment.signature: the car's painted name on the 1899 photo ringed in ink, then decoded: JAMAIS, არასდროს; CONTENTE, კმაყოფილი; the callback the ending lands on
